description: This file is a shell test script that verifies the behavior of 'git reset' commands in various scenarios. It contains setup commands, test cases for resetting staged files, HEAD, specific files, with and without options, and validates the expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, runs commands, and checks for success.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks if a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks if a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Executes commands after the test completes, regardless of success/failure.
